item.title: "Choo Mi-ae is a brawler; I’m a 30-year semiconductor veteran worker" (“추미애는 싸움꾼, 난 반도체 경력 30년 일꾼”)
item.description:
"Choo Mi-ae is a brawler; I’m a 30-year semiconductor veteran worker" (“추미애는 싸움꾼, 난 반도체 경력 30년 일꾼”)

People Power Party candidate for Gyeonggi Province Governor, Yang Hyang-ja, said in an interview with this newspaper on the 8th, “I will make Gyeonggi Province a world-class semiconductor hub alongside Silicon Valley in the U.S. and Shenzhen in China.” Yang, a semiconductor expert often called a ‘high school graduate legend,’ was the first female executive at Samsung Electronics from a vocational high school background. (국민의힘 양향자 경기지사 후보는 지난 8일 본지 인터뷰에서 “경기도를 미국의 실리콘밸리, 중국의 선전과 함께 명실상부한 세계 3대 반도체 도시로 만들겠다”고 했다. 양 후보는 여상 출신으론 처음으로 삼성전자 상무에 발탁되면서 ‘고졸 신화’로 불려온 반도체 전문가다.)

Yang strongly criticized her competitors: Democratic Party candidate Choo Mi-ae and Reform Party candidate Cho Eung-cheon. Targeting Choo, a former judge who led the Democratic Party’s push to restructure the prosecution and courts, she said, “If he becomes governor, Gyeonggi Province will pay enormous conflict costs throughout his term.” Regarding Cho, a former prosecutor, she added, “I applaud his courage in running as a minor party candidate, but he cannot turn Gyeonggi Province into a battleground for judges and prosecutors.” On the possibility of a candidate merger with Cho, which has been floated by some in the opposition, Yang stated, “I believe we should join forces against the ruling party’s dominance and arrogant government, but I will win the election under the name Yang Hyang-ja.” (양 후보는 경쟁 후보인 더불어민주당 추미애, 개혁신당 조응천 후보에 대해선 강하게 비판했다. 민주당 검찰, 법원 개편을 주도해온 판사 출신의 추 후보를 겨냥해 “그가 도지사가 되면 임기 내내 경기도는 막대한 갈등 비용을 지불할 것”이라고 했다. 검사 출신인 조 후보에 대해서도 “군소정당 후보로 출마한 용기에 박수를 보내지만 경기도를 판·검사 싸움판으로 만들 순 없다”고 했다. 양 후보는 야권 일각에서 나오는 조 후보와의 후보 단일화 가능성에 대해선 “여당 독주와 오만한 정권에 맞서 싸울 세력과는 함께 해야 한다는 생각”이라면서도 “저는 양향자의 이름으로 선거에서 승리할 것”이라고 했다.)

-You were nominated as the candidate after many twists and turns. (-우여곡절 끝에 후보로 선출됐는데.)

“In early March, I applied for the nomination and completed the interview, but I received no response from the party while an additional recruitment process was underway. After a close race, I won the primary, but honestly, it would be a lie to say I felt no disappointment or hurt towards the party. However, I persevered thanks to party members who urged me to win so that the People Power Party could make a fresh start in Gyeonggi Province. It was a time that clarified why we must win this election.” (“3월 초 공천 신청을 하고 면접까지 마쳤는데 당에서 아무 연락을 못받은 상황에서 추가 공모가 진행됐다. 후보들과 접전 끝에 경선에서 승리했지만 솔직히 당에 서운함과 섭섭함이 없었다면 거짓말이다. 그러나 경기도에서 국민의힘이 새롭게 출발할 수 있도록 꼭 이겨달라는 당원들의 말씀으로 버텼다. 왜 이 선거를 이겨야 하는지 분명해진 시간이었다.”)

-Why did you decide to run for Gyeonggi Province Governor? (-왜 경기지사에 도전했나.)

“My lifelong mission is to create a country where the people prosper and a Republic of Korea that no one can challenge. In short, we must build a nation with scientific and technological supremacy. To achieve this, Gyeonggi Province must become the heart of South Korea’s semiconductor industry. This is something only I can do, with over 30 years of experience in the semiconductor field. That’s also why I stepped forward to run in the most challenging region when the party was at its most difficult.” (“제 평생의 업은 국민이 잘사는 나라, 누구도 건드릴 수 없는 대한민국을 만드는 것이다. 한 마디로 과학기술 패권 국가를 만들어야 한다. 그러기 위해선 경기도가 대한민국 반도체 산업 현장의 심장이 돼야 한다. 30년 넘게 반도체 산업 현장에 있었던 저만이 할 수 있는 일이다. 당이 가장 어려울 때 가장 어려운 지역의 선거에 나선 이유도 이 때문이다.”)

-What are your key pledges? (-핵심 공약은 뭔가.)

“I will attract semiconductor clusters to other areas like Icheon and Hwaseong to usher in an era where Gyeonggi Province’s GRDP (Gross Regional Domestic Product) per capita reaches 100 million won. I plan to make Gyeonggi Province a world-class semiconductor city alongside Silicon Valley in the U.S. and Shenzhen in China. Additionally, I will use AI to reduce inefficiencies, irrationalities, and corruption costs in provincial administration, securing funds to provide welfare policies like free internet and OTT (online video streaming) services to residents. As a 41-year resident of Gyeonggi Province, I will also take responsibility for solving the ‘traffic hell’ issues I’ve personally experienced.” (“이천·화성처럼 다른 지역도 반도체 클러스터를 유치해 경기도 1인당 GRDP(지역내총생산) 1억원 시대를 열겠다. 경기도를 미국의 실리콘밸리, 중국의 선전과 함께 명실상부한 세계 3대 반도체 도시로 만들 계획이다. 또 AI(인공지능)를 활용해 도정의 비효율·불합리·비리 비용을 줄여 확보한 재원으로 도민들에게 무료 인터넷, OTT(온라인 동영상 서비스) 등 복지 정책을 제공하고 41년차 경기도민으로서 직접 느낀 ‘교통 지옥’ 문제도 책임지고 해결하겠다.”)

-How would you evaluate current Governor Kim Dong-yeon’s four-year administration? (-김동연 현 지사의 지난 4년 도정을 평가해달라.)

“Governor Kim hasn’t done anything particularly wrong, but he also hasn’t done anything particularly right. For example, allocating provincial budgets to cities and counties has widened the gap between the northern and southern regions based on their respective revenue sizes. He’s created a policy blind spot in the north and then proposes splitting it into a ‘Gyeonggi North Province,’ which is not a solution.” (“김 지사가 특별히 잘못 한 건 없지만 특별히 잘한 것도 없다. 예를 들어 도 사업에 시·군 예산을 나눠 투입하다보니 (시·군별 세입 규모에 따른) 남·북부 격차가 더 심해졌다. 북부에 정책 사각 지대를 만들어놓고선 ‘경기북도’로 분리하겠다고 하는데 해법이 아니다.")

-How would you evaluate candidate Choo Mi-ae? (-추미애 후보를 평가한다면.)

“I don’t understand why someone who served as a judge and a five-term lawmaker in Seoul suddenly served as a two-term lawmaker in Hanam Gap, Gyeonggi, and is now running for Gyeonggi Governor. Residents are saying, ‘Why is Choo Mi-ae coming here?’ He recently served as chairman of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee, passing all kinds of bad laws that caused conflict. If such a person takes charge of Gyeonggi Province, it would be a disaster. This election will be a showdown between a brawler and a semiconductor worker. I hope candidate Choo continues his strategy of ‘doing nothing’ by riding on President Lee Jae-myung’s approval ratings.” (“판사 하다가 서울에서 5선 의원 한 사람이 갑자기 경기 하남갑 국회의원을 2년 하다가 경기지사로 출마한 이유를 모르겠다. 도민들도 ‘추미애는 여기가 어디라고 오나’라고 한다. 최근까지 국회 법제사법위원장으로 있으면서 온갖 악법을 처리해 갈등을 유발시켰는데, 그런 사람이 경기도를 맡으면 큰 재앙이다. 이번 선거는 싸움꾼 대 반도체 일꾼의 구도가 될 것이다. 추 후보는 이재명 대통령 지지율에 편승하는 ‘아무 것도 안 하기’ 전략을 계속 해주길 바란다.”)

-What about candidate Cho Eung-cheon? (-조응천 후보는 어떤가.)

“Candidate Cho is also a legal technician. Let those two legal technicians fight it out among themselves, and I’ll focus on my job. I want Yang Hyang-ja’s success—starting semiconductor fieldwork at 18 and reaching here—to inspire the children of Gyeonggi Province. (Tears)” (“조 후보도 법률 기술자다. 법률 기술자 두 분끼리 알아서 싸우고 저는 제 할 일을 하겠다. 18살에 반도체 현장 일을 시작해 여기까지 온 양향자의 성공이 경기도 아이들에게 이어지도록 하겠다.(눈물)”)

-Is there a possibility of a candidate merger with Cho? (-조 후보와 단일화 가능성은 있나.)

“I can cooperate with those who share the same goal. But discussing a merger with another party candidate right after being confirmed as my party’s nominee doesn’t align with my life’s path. There’s no merger on my mind right now. If an election cannot be won with the People Power Party’s strength alone, it cannot be won through a merger either.” (“같은 목표를 갖고 연대할 수 있다. 그런데 당 후보로 확정되자마자 다른 당 후보와의 단일화 얘기를 하는 건 제가 살아온 궤적과 맞지 않는다. 지금 제 머릿속에는 단일화가 없다. 국민의힘 힘으로 승리할 수 없는 선거는 단일화해도 승리할 수 없다.”)

-Some realists argue that you can’t defeat Choo without a merger. (-‘단일화 없이 추 후보를 이길 수 있겠냐’는 현실론도 있다.)

“That’s a thoroughly defeatist frame. Even if a merger succeeds, Reform Party members won’t come to our party. Given the strong anger toward the People Power Party among Reform Party members, their support is likely to lean toward the Democratic Party.” (“그건 철저한 패배주의 프레임이다. 단일화에 성공한대도 개혁신당 당원들은 우리 당에 안 온다. 국민의힘에 대한 분노가 큰 개혁신당 당원들의 지지 성향상 민주당 쪽으로 갈 것이다.”)

-The People Power Party’s approval rating in Gyeonggi is lower than the Democratic Party’s. (-경기에서 국민의힘 지지율이 민주당에 비해 낮다.)

“That’s the reality. But my approval rating among the youth is relatively high. I plan to carefully prepare policies for the 20s and 30s, gain recognition from the middle-aged and elderly based on that, and boost overall approval across all age groups.” (“현실은 그렇다. 하지만 저에 대한 청년층 지지율은 높은 편이다. 20·30대를 위한 정책을 꼼꼼히 준비한 뒤 이를 기반으로 중장년층의 인정을 받아 전체 연령층 지지율을 끌어올릴 계획이다.”)

-You’ve previously criticized the leadership line of Jang Dong-hyuk. (-그동안 장동혁 지도부 노선을 비판해왔는데.)

“It came from a place of concern for the nation and the party. But now, we have no choice but to unite as one. If a war has broken out, and Representative Jang Dong-hyuk resigns, is there an alternative? Representative Jang must also set aside personal ambitions, like thinking about the next party leadership. We must stick to the path of integration and victory, whether we live or die. I will request Representative Jang to come and campaign for me. A strong team is one team, and one team is a strong team.” (“국가를 생각하고 당을 걱정하는 마음이었다. 그러나 이제는 하나로 똘똘 뭉쳐서 갈 수밖에 없다. 전쟁이 벌어졌는데 장동혁 대표가 사퇴한다면 대안은 있나. 장 대표도 다음 당권을 생각한다든지 사적 욕망을 내려놔야 한다. 죽든 살든 통합과 승리의 길로 끝까지 가야 한다. 장 대표에게 지원 유세를 요청할 것아다. 강팀은 원팀이고, 원팀이 강팀이다.”)

☞Who is Yang Hyang-ja (☞양향자는 누구)

Born in Hwasun, South Jeolla Province, she graduated from Gwangju Girls’ Commercial High School. In 1985, she joined Samsung Electronics as a research assistant in the semiconductor memory design office and became the first female executive with a high school diploma in 2013. Ahead of the 2016 general election, she was recruited by the Democratic Party and ran in Gwangju but lost due to the ‘People’s Party wave.’ She won in the same district in the 2020 general election but left the Democratic Party the following year. In 2023, she founded the Hope of Korea party, which later merged with the Reform Party. Ahead of last year’s presidential election, she joined the People Power Party and was elected as a Supreme Council member in August of that year. (전남 화순 출신으로 광주여상을 졸업했다. 1985년 삼성전자 반도체 메모리설계실 연구보조원으로 입사해 2013년 고졸 출신 첫 여성 임원이 됐다. 2016년 총선을 앞두고 민주당에 영입됐고 광주에 출마했지만 ‘국민의당 바람’으로 낙선했다. 2020년 총선 때 같은 지역에서 당선됐다가 이듬해 민주당을 탈당했다. 2023년 한국의희망을 창당했고 이어 개혁신당과 합당했다. 작년 대선을 앞두고는 국민의힘에 입당했고 그해 8월 최고위원으로 선출됐다.)

item.title: Kim Gwan-young's Run Shakes Up 'Ruling Party Stronghold' North Jeolla (김관영 출마에… ‘與 텃밭’ 전북 요동)
item.description:
Kim Gwan-young's Run Shakes Up 'Ruling Party Stronghold' North Jeolla (김관영 출마에… ‘與 텃밭’ 전북 요동)

The Democratic Party of Korea on the 10th stated regarding North Jeolla Governor Kim Gwan-young's independent bid, "This is a rejection of the party nomination and a serious act of betrayal," adding, "He can never be reinstated." The party took a hard-line stance as the governor's election in the ruling party's stronghold of North Jeolla turned into a two-way race following Governor Kim, who was expelled from the Democratic Party over allegations of proxy payment, entering the race. <<> Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae said during a press briefing that day that the party would take decisive action if any party member is confirmed to be supporting an independent candidate, adding this remark. This is aimed at blocking any behind-the-scenes support for Governor Kim. Previously, after expelling Governor Kim, the Democratic Party selected candidate Lee Won-taek from the pro-Jeong Cheong-rae faction as its North Jeolla governor candidate, and Governor Kim declared his independent bid, calling it "a 'Kill Kim Gwan-young' disciplinary action led by leader Jeong Cheong-rae." In response, Secretary General Cho also said that day, "He doesn't even deserve to engage in politics" and "He is shameless." Governor Kim's camp immediately pushed back, stating, "Under the leadership of Jeong Cheong-rae, who is blinded by self-interest, we wouldn't want reinstatement even if offered." <<> Regarding the Democratic Party's hard-line response, some say, "It's because with the incumbent governor running, they can't be confident of victory." A Democratic Party official commented, "There are murmurs that public sentiment in North Jeolla is unstable," adding, "If they were to lose North Jeolla, it would inevitably be a huge blow to leader Jeong, who is seeking re-election as party leader." (더불어민주당은 10일 김관영 전북지사의 무소속 출마에 대해 “공천 불복이고 중대한 해당(害黨) 행위”라며 “영원히 복당이 불가하다”고 했다. ‘대리비 지급 의혹’으로 민주당에서 제명된 김 지사의 출마로 여당 텃밭인 전북지사 선거가 2파전 양상을 보이자 강경 대응에 나선 것이다.)

item.title: “The Democratic Party Indicts Dropped, the People Power Party Martial Law… Break the Cartel of Two Parties That Have Violated the Constitution” (“민주는 공소취소, 국힘은 비상계엄… 헌법 유린한 양당의 카르텔 깨달라”)
item.description:
“The Democratic Party Indicts Dropped, the People Power Party Martial Law… Break the Cartel of Two Parties That Have Violated the Constitution” (“민주는 공소취소, 국힘은 비상계엄… 헌법 유린한 양당의 카르텔 깨달라”)

Cho Eung-cheon, the Reform Party candidate for Gyeonggi Province governor, said in an interview with this newspaper, “The Democratic Party of Korea is stuck in the ‘dropped indictment’ of Lee Jae-myung’s case, and the People Power Party is trapped in the quagmire of martial law,” adding, “I want to create a change that breaks the cartel structure of the two parties that have violated the constitutional order.” (개혁신당 조응천 경기지사 후보는 본지 인터뷰에서 “더불어민주당은 이재명 대통령 사건 ‘공소 취소’, 국민의힘은 비상 계엄의 늪에 벗어나지 못했다”며 “헌법 질서를 유린한 양당의 카르텔 구조를 깨는 변화를 만들고 싶다”고 했다.)

Candidate Cho evaluated Democratic Party candidate Choo Mi-ae, People Power Party candidate Yang Hyang-ja, and himself as “a bad candidate, a strange candidate, and a good candidate,” respectively, and said, “As a two-term lawmaker who has worked with the provincial residents for eight years, I believe I can empathize more with their joys, sorrows, and cries than other candidates.” Regarding the unification of opposition candidates, he stated, “The People Power Party still hasn’t shaken off the ‘Yoon again’ mindset,” and said he would complete the election without unification. (조 후보는 민주당 추미애 후보, 국민의힘 양향자 후보, 본인을 각각 “나쁜 후보, 이상한 후보, 좋은 후보”라고 평가하며 “(재선 의원으로) 8년간 도민과 함께해 온 내가 다른 후보들보다 도민의 애환과 절규에 공감할 수 있다고 생각한다”고 했다. 야권 후보 단일화에 대해선 “국민의힘은 아직 ‘윤 어게인’을 끊지 못했다”며 단일화 없이 선거를 완주하겠다고 했다.)

Cho graduated from Seoul National University’s law school, worked as a prosecutor, served as the Senior Secretary for Public Discipline in Park Geun-hye’s presidential office, and was a two-term Democratic Party lawmaker (Namyangju Gap, Gyeonggi Province). He left the Democratic Party in 2024, criticizing it for focusing on shielding then-leader Lee Jae-myung, and joined the Reform Party. (조 후보는 서울대 법대를 졸업하고 검사로 일했고, 박근혜 청와대 공직기강비서관, 더불어민주당 재선 국회의원(경기 남양주갑)을 지냈다. 민주당이 이재명 당시 대표 방탄에 몰두한다고 비판하며 2024년 탈당해 개혁신당에 입당했다.)

-Why did you run for Gyeonggi Province governor? (-경기지사에 출마한 이유는.)

“As someone who has always prioritized public values and spoken with one consistent voice, I must take the helm of the Gyeonggi provincial government to ensure it doesn’t bow to the central government and can speak up for the interests of the provincial residents.” (“공적 가치를 최우선으로 두고 항상 같은 목소리를 내온 내가 경기도정을 맡아야 중앙 정권에 굴종하지 않고, 도민의 이익을 위해 목소리를 낼 수 있다.”)

-Please introduce your pledges. (-공약을 소개해 달라.)

“Provincial residents commuting to Seoul have to line up to catch the wide-area bus, rain or shine, even if they have physiological needs. We can create an app that issues queue numbers using their smartphones at bus stops. Many elderly people also don’t know if they qualify for welfare benefits. I will implement a notification service using AI analysis that delivers simple messages quarterly, like ‘Apply for basic pension this month.’” (“서울로 출퇴근하는 도민이 광역버스를 타려면 비가 오나 눈이 오나, 생리 현상이 있어도 줄을 서 있어야 한다. 정류장에서 휴대폰을 이용해 대기 번호를 발급하는 앱을 만들면 된다. 본인이 복지 대상에 해당하는지 모르는 어르신도 많다. AI(인공지능) 분석을 통해 분기별로 ‘이번 달에 기초연금 신청하세요’ 같은 쉬운 말로 풀어낸 알림 서비스도 하겠다.”)

-The issue of a special counsel law for the ‘fabricated indictment’ is hot. (-‘조작기소’ 특검법 이슈가 뜨겁다.)

“Many provincial residents are outraged.” (“분개하는 도민이 많다.”)

-Do you think you have a chance to win in a three-way race? (-3자 구도에도 승산이 있다고 보나.)

“Even if Choo Mi-ae is well-known, it’s notorious. I don’t know what Yang Hyang-ja is thinking. Compared to those two candidates, I have better scalability. I am gaining support from moderates and soft supporters of the Democratic Party and the People Power Party due to the two parties’ violations of the constitutional order.” (“추미애 후보는 인지도가 높을지라도 그건 노토리어스(Notorious·악명 높은)한 것이다. 양향자 후보는 무슨 생각인지 모르겠다. 두 후보에 비해 나는 확장성이 좋다. 민주당·국민의힘이 헌법 질서를 유린하는 데 대해 중도층이나 연성 민주당·국민의힘 지지층으로부터 지지를 받고 있다.")

item.title: Jung Won-oh: "25,000 Won for Adopting a Stray Dog" – Oh Se-hoon: "Accelerate Completion of 7 Urban Railway Lines" (정원오 “유기견 입양하면 25만원” 오세훈 “7개 도시철도 조기 완공”)
item.description:
Jung Won-oh: "25,000 Won for Adopting a Stray Dog" – Oh Se-hoon: "Accelerate Completion of 7 Urban Railway Lines" (정원오 “유기견 입양하면 25만원” 오세훈 “7개 도시철도 조기 완공”)

Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, announced on the 10th a pet-related pledge to provide up to 250,000 won to households adopting stray animals. During his tenure as head of Seongdong District, he had offered 250,000 won in cash to families adopting strays, and now he aims to expand this to all of Seoul. (정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보는 10일 유기 동물 입양 가정에 최대 25만원을 주는 반려동물 공약을 발표했다. 성동구청장 재임 시절 유기 동물을 입양하는 가정에 현금 25만원을 지급했었는데 이를 서울 전역으로 확대하겠다는 것이다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Candidate Jung stated, "Pet-owning families in Seoul already account for 30% of households, and the number of registered pet dogs exceeds 610,000." He added, "By establishing a welfare system spanning adoption, care, medical treatment, and pet funeral services, I will create a city where pet owners and non-pet owners can safely coexist." Candidate Jung visited a pet training and stray dog shelter located in Gyeongdong Market in Dongdaemun-gu, Seoul, dressed in a sky-blue knit top and beige cotton pants. <<> Candidate Jung also pledged to push for the installation of public pet funeral facilities. Additionally, to address care gaps for single-person households and elderly households, he proposed setting up "public pet boarding centers" in all 25 districts and installing dedicated pet drinking fountains below public park water stations. He also mentioned promoting psychological counseling for pet loss syndrome (depression felt after a pet dies). However, he did not disclose specific budget or funding plans. Online communities reacted, saying, "Urgent issues like youth unemployment, low birth rates, and elderly living alone are piling up—hasn't the priority gotten out of order?" (정 후보는 이날 페이스북 글에서 “서울의 반려 가족은 이미 30%에 이르고 있고, 등록 반려견은 61만마리가 넘는다”며 “입양부터 돌봄, 진료, 장묘까지 이어지는 복지 체계를 구축해 반려인과 비반려인이 함께 안전하게 공존하는 도시를 만들겠다”고 했다. 정 후보는 이날 하늘색 니트와 베이지색 면바지 차림으로 서울 동대문구 경동시장 내 반려동물 훈련·유기견 보호 시설을 찾았다.)

Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, unveiled a "Transport Artery Connection" project plan on the same day, involving an investment of 20.8 trillion won. He aims to accelerate the completion of seven urban railway lines: the Gangbuk Transversal Line, Myeonmok Line, Seobu Line, Mokdong Line, Nangok Line, Ui-Shin Seol Extension Line, and Dongbuk Line. He also proposed upgrading the public bicycle system "Ttareungyi" from its current 3-speed gear to a 7- or 8-speed gear, addressing past complaints about difficulty riding uphill. Candidate Oh urged Candidate Jung to hold a prompt two-way debate. He said, "Following the Gwanhun Debate, the broadcast journalists' club debate also fell through as a two-way format. Regardless of when or how, I ask you to respond quickly to a two-way debate." (정 후보는 공공 반려동물 장묘 시설 설치도 추진하겠다고 했다. 이와 함께 1인 가구 및 고령 가구 등의 돌봄 공백을 해소하기 위해 25개 구에 ‘공공 펫 위탁소’를 설치하고, 공원 음수대 하단에는 반려동물 전용 음수대를 설치하겠다고 했다. 펫로스 증후군(반려동물이 죽었을 때 느끼는 우울증) 심리 상담 등도 추진한다. 다만 구체적 예산과 재원 마련 방안은 밝히지 않았다. 인터넷 커뮤니티에선 “청년 취업난, 저출산, 독거노인 문제 등 시급한 문제가 산적한 데 우선 순위가 뒤바뀐 것 아니냐”는 반응이 나왔다.)

item.title: Park Min-shik with Party Leadership, Han Dong-hoon with Locals… ‘Three-Way Confrontation’ at Same-Day Campaign Launches (박민식은 黨지도부, 한동훈은 지역민과… 한날 출정식서 ‘세 대결’)
item.description:
Park Min-shik with Party Leadership, Han Dong-hoon with Locals… ‘Three-Way Confrontation’ at Same-Day Campaign Launches (박민식은 黨지도부, 한동훈은 지역민과… 한날 출정식서 ‘세 대결’)

On June 3, candidates for the Busan North-Gap by-election—Park Min-shik of the People Power Party and independent Han Dong-hoon—both held campaign office opening ceremonies at 2 PM on the 10th. With assessments that the election outcome could significantly impact the conservative camp, the two candidates engaged in a tense standoff. The scenes at their opening events, just 600 meters apart in a straight line, were starkly contrasting. (6월 3일 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 국민의힘 박민식 후보와 무소속 한동훈 후보가 10일 오후 2시에 나란히 선거 사무소 개소식을 열었다. 선거 결과에 따라 보수 진영에 미치는 영향이 적지 않다는 평가가 나오는 가운데 두 후보는 팽팽한 기싸움을 벌였다. 직선거리로 600m 떨어진 양측 개소식의 풍경도 대조적이었다.)

At Park’s opening ceremony, attendees included People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, floor leader Song Eon-seok, supreme council members Kim Min-su, Kim Jae-won, and Jo Gwang-han, secretary-general Jeong Hee-yong, and Busan mayor candidate Park Hyung-joon. Senior lawmakers such as Kwon Young-se, Kim Ki-hyun, Na Kyung-won, Jo Bae-sook, and Ahn Cheol-soo were present, along with former Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Won Hee-ryong. Among the 17 People Power Party lawmakers from Busan, nine attended: Lee Heon-seung, Park Soo-young, Baek Jong-heon, Jeong Dong-man, Kwak Kyu-taek, Park Sung-hoon, Seo Ji-young, Jo Seung-hwan, and Joo Jin-woo. (박 후보 개소식엔 국민의힘 장동혁 대표와 송언석 원내대표, 김민수·김재원·조광한 최고위원, 정희용 사무총장, 박형준 부산시장 후보가 참석했다. 권영세·김기현·나경원·조배숙·안철수 의원 등 중진 의원들과 원희룡 전 국토교통부 장관 등이 참석했다. 국민의힘 부산 의원 17명 가운데 이헌승·박수영·백종헌·정동만·곽규택·박성훈·서지영·조승환·주진우 의원 등 9명이 참석했다.)

In his congratulatory speech, leader Jang Dong-hyuk said, “I know you’re disappointed in the People Power Party. It’s likely because we’ve been in conflict and division among ourselves.” He added, “Shouldn’t we now renew the People Power Party? We need Park Min-shik, who has steadfastly defended conservatism, not those who sow seeds of conflict and division or try to exploit the party.” This was interpreted as a remark targeting Han Dong-hoon. (장동혁 대표는 축사에서 “국민의힘에 실망한 것을 잘 알고 있다. 우리끼리 갈등·분열했기 때문일 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “이제 국민의힘을 새롭게 고쳐야 하지 않겠느냐”며 “갈등과 분열의 씨앗을 뿌린 사람, 국민의힘을 이용하려고 하는 사람들이 아니라 굳건하게 보수를 지켜온 박민식이 필요하다”고 했다. 한 후보를 겨냥한 발언으로 해석됐다.)

At the same time, Han Dong-hoon’s campaign office drew local residents and supporters, including merchants from the Gupo Market, a former police chief, a former high school principal, and others. Political figures included former lawmaker Seo Byung-soo, honorary election committee chair, and those close to Han. Pro-Han lawmakers did not attend. With the People Power Party leadership hinting at disciplinary action if they supported the expelled Han, it was said that Han himself discouraged their attendance. (같은 시각 한동훈 후보 선거 사무소엔 구포시장 상인, 전직 경찰서장, 전직 고등학교장 등 지역 주민과 지지자들이 모여들었다. 정치인으로는 명예 선거대책위원장인 서병수 전 의원과 친한계 인사들이 참석했다. 친한계 의원들은 참석하지 않았다. 국민의힘 지도부가 제명된 한 후보를 지원할 경우 징계를 시사한 가운데, 한 후보가 참석을 만류했다고 한다.)

The opening ceremony also invited an elderly street vendor who had prepared a bowl of sticky rice for Han. At that time, the grandmother had said, “You should become president,” and the scene of Han sitting on the street eating the meal became a hot topic. Han said that day, “If I go from North-Gap to the Blue House, I’ll bring you along first.” He also invited a middle school girl with Down syndrome and her mother, whom he had met during his campaign. (개소식엔 한 후보를 위해 찰밥 도시락을 준비했던 노점상 할머니도 초청됐다. 당시 할머니는 “대통령이 돼야지”라고 했고 한 후보가 길에 앉아 도시락을 먹는 장면이 화제가 됐다. 한 후보는 이날 “제가 북구갑에서 청와대로 가면 어머님을 제일 먼저 모시겠다”고 했다. 한 후보는 유세 중에 만났던 다운증후군 장애가 있는 여중생과 어머니도 초청했다.)

With the election unfolding as a three-way race, recent polls show Ha Jung-woo of the Democratic Party of Korea leading ahead of Park and Han. This has led to predictions that conservative candidate unification could become a key variable. For now, both candidates say they will complete the race without unification. Park, targeting Han, said, “If people who show up out of nowhere like ‘fly-by-night operations’ say they’ll develop North-gu, would you believe them? The conservatives doing internal attacks, the self-righteous conservatives—those old-fashioned conservatism must now step aside.” In response, Han said, “Is that what you call internal attacks? Isn’t it because many don’t agree with your remarks that this (conservative split) situation has emerged?” Meanwhile, Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon and a majority of People Power Party lawmakers from Busan support candidate unification in North-Gap for the sake of the overall Busan election. (선거가 3자 구도로 치러지는 가운데 최근 여론조사에서 더불어민주당 하정우 후보는 박 후보와 한 후보를 앞서고 있다. 이 때문에 보수 후보 단일화가 변수가 될 것이라는 전망이다. 일단 두 후보는 단일화 없이 선거를 완주하겠다는 입장이다. 박 후보는 한 후보를 겨냥해 “떴다방처럼 난데없이 날아온 사람들이 북구를 발전시키겠다고 하면 여러분 믿으시겠냐”며 “내부 총질하는 보수, 유아독존적인 보수, 그런 구태 보수는 이제 물러가야 한다”고 했다. 이에 한 후보는 “그게 내부 총질”이라며 “많은 분이 (그런 발언에) 동의하지 않으니까 이런 (보수 분열) 상황이 생기는 것 아니냐”고 했다. 반면 박형준 부산시장 후보와 국민의힘 부산 의원 상당수는 부산 전체 선거를 위해 부산 북갑 후보 단일화가 필요하다는 입장이다.)

However, the conservative camp spoke in unison on the ‘dictatorship judgment theory,’ criticizing the ruling party’s rampage—such as pushing for a special counsel law with the power to revoke indictments—as ‘dictatorship.’ Leader Jang Dong-hyuk told this newspaper about the Democratic Party’s ‘insurrection judgment theory,’ stating, “This election is one to block Lee Jae-myung’s dictatorship and end the dictatorial regime. We must judge dictator Lee Jae-myung and restore the Republic of Korea as a liberal democratic republic.” Han said on the 9th, “If President Yoon actually revokes the indictment, he should be impeached.” (다만 야권은 공소 취소 권한을 가진 특검법 추진 등 여당의 폭주를 ‘독재’로 규정하고, 이를 비판하는 ‘독재 심판론’에 있어선 한 목소리를 냈다. 장동혁 대표는 이날 본지에 민주당이 ‘내란 심판론’을 내세운 것에 대해 “이번 선거는 이재명 독재를 막고 독재 정권을 끝장내는 선거”라며 “독재자 이재명을 심판하고 대한민국을 다시 자유민주주의 공화국으로 돌려놓아야 한다”고 했다. 한 후보는 9일 “이 대통령이 실제로 공소 취소를 하면 탄핵돼야 한다”고 했다.)

At Park Min-shik’s campaign office opening that day, eight Busan lawmakers—Cho Kyung-tae, Kim Do-eup, Kim Hee-jung, Kim Mi-ae, Lee Seong-kwon, Kim Dae-shik, Jeong Seong-guk, and Jeong Yeon-uk—were absent. Kim Hee-jung (due to a Seoul schedule) and Kim Dae-shik (on overseas business) cited other commitments. A conservative source said, “It seems like a signal to pressure unification of the two candidates.” (이날 박민식 후보 선거 사무소 개소식에 부산 지역 조경태·김도읍·김희정·김미애·이성권·김대식·정성국·정연욱 의원 등 8명은 불참했다. 김희정(서울 일정), 김대식(해외 출장) 의원은 다른 일정이 있었다고 한다. 야권 관계자는 “두 후보의 단일화를 압박하는 차원의 의사 표시인 것 같다”고 했다.)

Within the conservative camp, there is talk that the Busan North-Gap election outcome will also affect the future of the People Power Party leadership and the next party leadership race. If Park Min-shik, backed by Jang Dong-hyuk’s leadership, wins, it is analyzed that Jang’s faction or the current mainstream party leadership will find it easier to maintain power. Conversely, if Han—expelled by Jang—wins, voices for Jang’s resignation could grow, led by pro-Han lawmakers and those emphasizing party unity. A political source said, “If the two sides’ conflict leads to the Democratic Party’s Ha Jung-woo winning, blame disputes could intensify conservative division.” (야권에선 부산 북갑 선거의 결과가 향후 국민의힘 지도부의 거취와 차기 당권 경쟁에도 영향을 미칠 것이라는 말도 나온다. 장동혁 지도부가 지원에 나선 박민식 후보가 당선될 경우 장 대표 측 또는 당내 현 주류 세력의 당권 유지가 수월해질 것이란 분석이다. 반면 장 대표가 제명한 한 후보가 당선된다면, 친한계와 당내 통합을 강조한 의원들을 중심으로 장 대표 퇴진 등의 목소리가 커질 가능성이 있다. 정치권 관계자는 “양측의 갈등으로 민주당 하정우 후보가 당선된다면, 책임론을 놓고 보수 분열이 더 극심해질 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo Also Holds Campaign Launch… Embraces Jeon Jae-soo as "One Team" (하정우도 개소식… 전재수와 “원팀” 포옹)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo Also Holds Campaign Launch… Embraces Jeon Jae-soo as "One Team" (하정우도 개소식… 전재수와 “원팀” 포옹)

Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate running in the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election, said at his campaign office opening ceremony on the 10th, "I will join hands with the Busan mayor for the development of Buk-gu. I will meet with ministers and the presidential chief of staff. I will even negotiate directly with the president." The party leadership, including Jeong Cheong-rae, did not attend the ceremony. Instead, Jeon Jae-soo, the Busan mayoral candidate who served as the area's lawmaker until recently, and others were present to support Ha. <<> Ha emphasized on the day, "In the AI era, cities that set direction first and execute quickly will take the lead," asserting that he is the right person to lead Buk-gu's development. He also targeted People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, saying, "I didn't enter politics to pick fights. I'm not someone trying to make a name using Buk-gu or use it as a stepping stone." <<> Candidate Jeon Jae-soo said, "If Jeon Jae-soo's 'dream of a maritime capital' and Ha Jung-woo's 'dream of making South Korea one of the top three AI powers' combine, Busan will undergo a transformative change." Jeon also performed a symbolic act of handing a baton inscribed with "Buk-gu's Future" to Ha. Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae visited Jeon's campaign office opening the previous day but skipped Ha's event to attend the launch of Min Hyung-bae's election committee for the Gwangju-Jeonnam Integrated Special City mayoral race. A Democratic Party official remarked, "It would be a lie to say the 'oppa' controversy wasn't a factor." <<> Ha is leading Park and Han outside the margin of error in recent polls but remains stuck below the 40% mark. A MetaVoice survey commissioned by JTBC on the 4th and 5th, asking 501 voters in the district, showed Ha's support at 37%, surpassing Park (26%) and Han (25%). In hypothetical two-way races assuming opposition unification, he also held an advantage, but all results were within the margin of error. For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website. A Democratic Party official said, "The controversy over a 'special counsel for manipulated indictments' that could allow the withdrawal of the president's case is seen as having a significant negative impact in the Yeongnam region," adding, "Coupled with Ha's 'shaking hands then wiping his hand' and 'oppa' nickname controversies, unification between Park and Han is emerging as a key variable in the final stages." (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 더불어민주당 하정우 후보는 10일 선거사무소 개소식에서 “북구 발전을 위해 부산시장과 손 잡겠다. 장관들, 청와대비서실장도 만나겠다. 대통령과도 담판 짓겠다”고 말했다. 이날 개소식에는 정청래 지도부는 오지 않았다. 대신 직전까지 이 지역 국회의원을 지낸 전재수 부산시장 후보 등이 참석해 하 후보를 지원했다.)

item.title: Government Forced to Shift from Cautious Stance to Active Response (신중론 펴던 정부, 적극 대응 불가피)
item.description:
Government Forced to Shift from Cautious Stance to Active Response (신중론 펴던 정부, 적극 대응 불가피)

As a joint government investigation revealed on the 10th that the HMM's "Namuho," which caught fire while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, was "struck" by an unidentified aircraft, the South Korean government's approach—which had previously maintained that "it might not be an attack"—has inevitably changed. The presidential office Cheong Wa Dae convened a working-level committee of the National Security Council (NSC) on the same day, with participation from relevant ministries including the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries. This marks the first NSC meeting since the incident. (호르무즈 해협 정박 중 화재가 발생한 HMM ‘나무호’가 10일 정부 합동 조사 결과 미상의 비행체에 의해 ‘피격’된 것으로 드러나면서, 그동안 “피격이 아닐 수 있다”고 해온 우리 정부 대응 방식도 변화가 불가피해졌다. 청와대는 이날 해양수산부 등 관계 부처가 참여한 국가안전보장회의(NSC) 실무위원회를 개최했다. 이번 피격 이후 첫 NSC다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated, "We will thoroughly investigate the cause of the incident and pursue all possible measures, including cooperation with the international community, to prevent recurrence." Accordingly, the likelihood of South Korea participating in the 'Maritime Freedom Initiative' proposed by the U.S. to establish a multinational security coalition for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz has increased. There are also observations that, given the confirmed attack, if the safety of 26 South Korean vessels anchored in the Strait of Hormuz cannot be secured, plans to dispatch naval vessels may be considered. (외교부는 “사고 원인을 철저히 규명하고 재발 방지를 위해 국제사회와 공조를 비롯해 가능한 모든 방안을 추진하겠다”고 했다. 이에 따라 미국이 호르무즈 해협 통항 안전을 위해 다국적 안보 연합체를 만들자며 제안한 ‘해양 자유 구상’ 등에 우리가 참여할 가능성이 높아졌다. 피격이 확인된 이상, 호르무즈 해협에 정박 중인 우리 선박 26척의 안전이 확보되지 않을 경우 해군 함정을 파견하는 안이 검토될 수 있다는 관측도 나왔다.)

Within the ruling party, remarks like "the situation has completely changed" have emerged. The government had previously emphasized the possibility that it was not an attack, citing the fact that the Namuho had neither flooded nor listed. While the Ministry of Foreign Affairs declined to speculate on the perpetrator, stating it would "not prejudge," government officials acknowledged that "it is realistic to see Iran as the attacker." A ruling party insider commented, "In the current situation, if the government maintains a reserved stance, it could be seen as avoiding the issue. Shouldn't we take more active measures regarding ship navigation in the Strait of Hormuz?" (여권 내에서도 “상황이 완전히 바뀌었다”는 말이 나왔다. 정부는 그동안 나무호가 침수되거나 기울어지지 않은 점을 들어 피격이 아닐 가능성에 무게를 둬 왔다. 외교부는 이날 공격 주체에 대해 “예단하지 않겠다”고 했지만, 정부 인사들도 “공격 주체는 이란으로 보는 게 현실적”이라고 했다. 여권 관계자는 “지금 상황에서 정부가 유보적 태도만 취하는 건 상황을 회피하는 것으로 보일 수 있다”며 “호르무즈 해협 선박 통항에 좀 더 적극적인 조치에 나서야 되지 않겠느냐”고 했다.)

Before announcing the investigation results, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned Iranian Ambassador to South Korea Saeed Koozechi to the ministry building. The Iranian Embassy had previously denied allegations of Iran's involvement. When asked by reporters whether he still maintains that Iran has nothing to do with the fire on the Namuho, Ambassador Koozechi only replied, "Ask (Iran's) Ministry of Foreign Affairs." (외교부는 이날 조사 결과 발표에 앞서 사이드 쿠제치 주한 이란 대사를 외교부 청사로 불렀다. 주한이란대사관은 앞서 ‘이란 공격설’을 부인했었다. 쿠제치 대사는 여전히 나무호 화재와 무관하다는 입장이냐는 취재진 물음에 “(이란) 외교부에 물어보라”고만 했다.)

The People Power Party responded to the government's investigation results by stating, "If a specific force's attack is confirmed, we must respond decisively and immediately." Rep. Seong Il-jong of the People Power Party, chairman of the National Assembly's National Defense Committee, criticized, "It's absurd to see the government using vague terms like 'unidentified aircraft' when they could simply say 'attack.' If they truly didn't know, it's incompetence; if they knew but tried to conceal it ahead of the election, it's a serious issue." (국민의힘은 정부 조사 결과에 대해 “특정 세력 공격이 확인되면 단호하게 즉각 대응해야 한다”고 했다. 국회 국방위원장인 국민의힘 성일종 의원은 “피격이라는 쉬운 단어를 두고 미상의 비행체 운운하는 정부 모습에 기가 찬다”며 “정말로 몰랐다면 무능한 것이고, 알고도 선거를 앞두고 은폐하려 했다면 심각한 문제”라고 했다.)

item.title: Two Drones Struck the Stern of the NAMU (비행 드론 2기가 나무호 선미 때렸다)
item.description:
Two Drones Struck the Stern of the NAMU (비행 드론 2기가 나무호 선미 때렸다)

The government announced on the 10th the preliminary results of an investigation into the explosion and fire on the Korean HMM multipurpose carrier 'NAMU,' which occurred while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz on the 4th (local time). The cause was determined to be an 'external strike by an unidentified flying object.' The Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned the Iranian ambassador to South Korea that evening to convey the findings and verify the facts. If the perpetrator is identified, significant diplomatic repercussions are expected. (정부는 지난 4일(현지시각) 호르무즈 해협에서 정박 중 발생한 한국 HMM의 다목적 운반선 ‘나무(NAMU)호’ 폭발·화재 원인이 ‘미상(未詳)의 비행체에 의한 외부 타격’이라는 1차 조사 결과를 10일 발표했다. 외교부는 이날 저녁 주한 이란 대사를 불러 조사 결과를 전달하고 사실 관계를 확인했다. 공격 주체가 확정될 경우 외교적 파장이 커질 전망이다.)

Foreign Ministry spokesperson Park Il stated on the same day, "A joint government investigation team conducted on-site inspections on the 8th and confirmed that an unidentified flying object struck the stern of the HMM vessel on the 4th." Spokesperson Park added, "The flying object was captured on CCTV footage, but there are limitations in identifying the launch perpetrator, exact model, and physical size. We plan to conduct further analysis on debris, such as the engine remnants of the flying object, collected at the scene." Experts suggested that, considering the damage point and scale, an attack by drones rather than cruise missiles appears more likely. (박일 외교부 대변인은 이날 “정부 합동 조사단이 8일 현장 조사를 실시한 결과 4일 미상의 비행체가 HMM 선미를 타격한 것으로 확인됐다”고 밝혔다. 박 대변인은 “CCTV(방범카메라) 영상에 해당 비행체가 포착됐으나 발사 주체, 정확한 기종 및 물리적 크기 등을 확인하기에는 제약이 있는 상황”이라며 “현장에서 수거된 비행체 엔진 잔해 등을 추가 분석할 예정”이라고 했다. 전문가들은 피해 지점, 규모 등을 고려할 때 순항미사일보다는 드론에 의한 공격 가능성이 커 보인다고 했다.)

According to the joint investigation team's results released by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, at 3:30 PM local time on the 4th, two flying objects struck the stern ballast tank (a compartment storing water for ship balance) of the HMM NAMU in two separate strikes approximately one minute apart. The impact damaged the left stern plating, creating a breach about 5 meters wide and extending about 7 meters deep into the hull, puncturing the engine room floor and causing an internal fire. The government also disclosed a hemispherical penetration damage about 50 cm in diameter in the damaged hull. This evidence indicates an explosion originating from a small external point on the ship. A military source commented, "It seems highly likely that two drones struck the same spot in succession." (외교부가 발표한 합동 조사단 조사 결과에 따르면 4일 오후 3시 30분(현지 시각) 비행체 2기가 HMM 나무호 선미 평형수 탱크(배의 균형을 잡는 물을 저장하는 공간)를 약 1분 간격으로 2차례 타격했다. 이 충격으로 좌측 선미 외판은 폭 약 5m, 선체 내부로 깊이 약 7m까지 훼손됐고, 기관실 바닥이 뚫리며 내부에 화재가 발생했다. 정부는 이날 훼손된 선체에서 직경 50㎝ 크기의 반구형 관통 피해도 공개했다. 선체 외부의 작은 지점에서 생긴 폭발을 보여주는 증거다. 군 소식통은 “드론 2기가 동일 지점을 연타했을 가능성이 커 보인다”고 했다.)

◇First Strike Causes Explosion and Fire, Second Strike One Minute Later... 'Analyzing Engine Debris of Flying Object' (◇첫 피격에 폭발·화재, 1분 후 2차 타격… “비행체 엔진 잔해 분석 중”)

The NAMU, which was in the waters off Umm Al Quwain, UAE, at the time of the explosion, was unable to navigate under its own power and was towed to a repair shipyard in Dubai Port. A government investigation team, comprising three investigators from the Korean Maritime Safety Tribunal under the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and four forensic experts from the National Fire Agency, was dispatched to the site. From the 8th onward, they conducted on-site inspections of the NAMU at Dubai Port, reviewed CCTV footage, and interviewed the captain to investigate the fire's cause. They also reportedly secured CCTV footage showing the flying object attacking the vessel. (폭발 발생 당시 아랍에미리트(UAE) 움알쿠와인 해역에 있었던 나무호는 자력 운항이 불가능해 두바이항의 수리 조선소로 예인됐다. 해양수산부 산하 해양안전심판원 조사관 3명과 소방청 감식 전문가 4명으로 구성된 정부 조사단이 현지에 급파돼 두바이항에서 8일부터 나무호에 대한 현장 조사, CCTV 확인, 선장 면담 등 화재 원인 조사를 진행했다. 비행체가 배를 공격하는 CCTV 영상도 확보했다고 한다.)

The investigation team stated that the first strike by the flying object caused a fire in the engine room, and the subsequent second strike led to a rapid spread of the flames. No anomalies were found in the ship's engine, generator, or boiler. The strike scenario aligns with statements from the NAMU's crew. The crew reported hearing a "bang" explosion, and nearby Korean ships sent VHF radio communications saying, 'Smoke is visible on the left side of the vessel; it appears something has exploded.' The crew initiated firefighting efforts in the engine room, and the blaze was brought under control in four hours. At the time, the NAMU had 24 crew members on board, including 6 Korean nationals. While the presidential office had earlier stated there were no casualties from the explosion and fire, it was later reported that one crew member sustained a minor fracture to a neck bone due to the blast. (비행체의 1차 타격으로 기관실에서 불이 났고, 이후 2차 타격으로 화재 규모가 급격히 확산된 것으로 보인다고 조사단은 밝혔다. 선박의 엔진, 발전기, 보일러 등에서 특이점은 없었다. 피격 상황은 나무호 선원들 진술과도 일치한다. 선원들은 당시 “쾅” 하는 폭발음을 들었고, 인근 한국 선박들이 ‘선박 왼쪽에 연기가 보이는데 뭔가 폭발한 것 같다’고 보내온 초단파 무선통신(VHF)이 쏟아졌다. 선원들은 기관실에서 난 화재 진화에 나섰고, 불길은 4시간 만에 잡혔다. 당시 나무호에는 한국 선원 6명을 포함해 24명의 선원이 타고 있었다. 청와대는 앞서 폭발·화재로 인한 인명 피해가 없다고 했으나, 이날 폭발 여파로 선원 1명이 목뼈에 미세 골절 부상을 입은 것으로 알려졌다.)

◇Pattern of 'Double Tap' Attack Using Drones (◇드론 이용한 ‘더블 탭’ 공격 패턴)

The primarily damaged areas of the vessel were the ballast tank and engine room, located about 1 to 1.5 meters above the waterline. In damage photos released by the government, the outer plating of the NAMU's hull appears torn from the inside outward, suggesting the flying object approached from behind the ship, penetrated the stern, and exploded internally. Spokesperson Park also stated, "It is estimated that the fire cause is unrelated to the ship's interior." He added, "Considering the damage pattern from explosion pressure and the hemispherical penetration shape, the possibility of a strike by mines or torpedoes seems low." (선박이 주로 파손된 지점은 해수면보다 약 1~1.5m 상단의 평형수 탱크와 기관실이었다. 정부가 공개한 피해 사진에선 나무호 선체 외판이 안에서 바깥쪽으로 찢어져 있는 모습도 보인다. 비행체가 배 뒤로 접근해 선미를 뚫고 들어가 내부에서 폭발했기 때문인 것으로 추정된다. 박 대변인도 “화재 원인은 선박 내부와는 무관한 것으로 추정된다”고 했다. 박 대변인은 “폭발 압력으로 인한 파손 패턴과 반구형 관통 형상 부위를 고려할 때 기뢰 및 어뢰에 의한 피격 가능성은 낮은 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

Experts believe the one-minute interval between the collisions of the suspected drones with the NAMU suggests a 'calculated attack.' This appears to be a 'double tap tactic,' where two or more drones target a specific point: the first drone inflicts initial damage on the thick hull, and the second drone strikes the same spot to maximize damage to the structure and personnel. This method has been frequently used in the Russia-Ukraine war when drones attack buildings or large tankers. (전문가들은 드론으로 추정되는 비행체가 1분 간격으로 나무호와 충돌한 것은 ‘계산된 공격’일 가능성이 높다고 본다. 2대 이상의 드론이 공격 목표를 정하고, 첫 드론이 두꺼운 선체에 1차 피해를 주면 두 번째 드론이 같은 지점을 공격해 선체와 인명 피해를 극대화하는 ‘더블 탭(Double Tap) 전술’이라는 것이다. 이런 방식은 러시아·우크라이나 전쟁에서 드론으로 건물이나 대형 유조선을 공격할 때 빈번히 사용된다.)

◇Who is the Perpetrator? (◇공격 주체는 누구?)

The explosion on the NAMU occurred on the afternoon of the 4th, the same day the U.S. launched 'Project Freedom,' an operation to assist vessels trapped in the Strait of Hormuz in escaping. Iran, responding to the U.S. operation, launched attacks on the UAE using cruise missiles and drones on the same day. (나무호 폭발은 미국이 호르무즈 해협에 갇힌 선박들의 탈출을 지원하기 위한 작전인 ‘프로젝트 프리덤’에 나선 4일 당일 오후 발생했다. 이란은 같은 날 미국의 작전에 반발해 순항미사일과 드론 등으로 UAE 공격에 나섰다.)

Hours after the NAMU explosion, President Donald Trump stated, "Iran has fired several shots at countries not involved in the war, including a Korean cargo ship," identifying Iran as the perpetrator. However, the South Korean government, awaiting the investigation results from its team, had not held a National Security Council (NSC) meeting chaired by the president, stating it was "not clear whether it was an attack or not." At one point, the government had even suggested that the possibility of an attack seemed low. Spokesperson Park explained this by saying, "Initially, no breach was identified through the crew or nearby ships." (도널드 트럼프 대통령은 나무호 폭발 몇 시간 뒤 “이란이 한국의 화물선을 포함해 (전쟁과) 무관한 국가들을 향해 몇 차례 발포했다”며 발포 주체가 이란이라고 했다. 하지만 한국 정부는 정부 조사단 조사 결과가 나오기 전까지는 “피격인지 아닌지 분명치 않다”며 대통령 주재 국가안전보장회의(NSC) 등을 열지 않았다. 정부는 한때 피격 가능성이 낮아 보인다는 관측도 내놓은 바 있다. 이에 대해 박 대변인은 “당초 선원이나 인근 선박을 통해서는 파공을 식별하지 못했기 때문”이라고 했다.)

When asked about the perpetrator of the attack on the NAMU, Spokesperson Park replied, "We will not make premature judgments about the attacker," citing the need for forensic analysis of debris, including the flying object's engine. Nevertheless, in diplomatic circles, there is a tendency to suspect Iranian involvement. The fact that the government disclosed details about the Iranian ambassador to South Korea, Saeed Koozechi, visiting the Ministry of Foreign Affairs immediately after the announcement, and South Korea explaining the investigation results, adds weight to this speculation. (박 대변인은 나무호를 공격한 주체가 어디냐는 질문에 “공격의 주체에 대해서는 예단을 하지 않겠다”고 했다. 비행체 엔진 등 잔해에 대한 감식이 필요하다는 것이다. 다만 외교가에서는 이란 소행 가능성에 무게를 두고 있다. 정부 발표 직후 사이드 쿠제치 주한 이란 대사가 외교부를 방문했고, 한국 측이 조사 결과를 설명한 사실을 공개한 것도 그런 추정에 힘을 싣는다.)

◇Potential to Escalate into a Diplomatic Issue (◇외교 문제로 비화 가능성)

A diplomatic source stated, "If the Iranian military is found to be involved, it could escalate into a serious diplomatic issue affecting Korea-Iran relations. Therefore, it won't be easy to pinpoint the perpetrator until precise results are available." (외교 소식통은 “이란군이 연루된 것으로 드러날 경우 한·이란 관계 등 심각한 외교 문제로 비화할 수 있기 때문에 정밀 결과가 나오기 전까지 공격 주체를 특정하기는 쉽지 않을 것”이라고 했다.)

If this strike is confirmed as an Iranian act, the diplomatic fallout is expected to be significant. Iran has previously carried out drone and missile attacks on various ships, including U.S. naval vessels, in the Strait of Hormuz region. Consequently, speculation about Iranian involvement was strong right after the NAMU explosion and fire incident. (이번 피격 사건이 이란의 소행으로 확인될 경우 외교적 파장은 작지 않을 것으로 예상된다. 이란은 그간 호르무즈 해협 일대에서 미군 함정을 비롯해 각국 선박에 대한 드론과 미사일 공격을 감행해 왔다. 이에 나무호 폭발·화재 사건 발생 직후부터 이란 소행일 가능성에 무게가 실렸다.)

Regarding claims that the NAMU explosion was due to an Iranian military attack, Iran's state media, military authorities, and the Iranian embassy in Seoul have issued conflicting statements. Iran's state-run Press TV reported on the 6th that "a Korean ship violating maritime regulations was targeted." However, the Iranian embassy in Seoul stated, "We firmly deny any claims that the Iranian military was involved in the NAMU explosion." (이란은 나무호 폭발이 이란군의 공격 때문이라는 주장을 놓고 국영 언론 보도와 군 당국, 주한 이란 대사관 등이 제각각 목소리를 냈다. 이란 국영 프레스TV는 지난 6일 “해상 규정을 위반한 한국 선박을 표적으로 삼았다”고 보도했다. 하지만 주한 이란 대사관은 “나무호 폭발에 이란군이 연루됐다는 어떠한 주장도 단호히 부인한다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: The Two-Horse Carriage of 'No Charges for Bribery' and 'Motion to Withdraw Indictment and Special Counsel' Shakes Jeon Jae-soo (‘금품 무혐의’ ‘공소취소특검’이란 쌍두마차, 전재수를 흔든다)
item.description:
The Two-Horse Carriage of 'No Charges for Bribery' and 'Motion to Withdraw Indictment and Special Counsel' Shakes Jeon Jae-soo (‘금품 무혐의’ ‘공소취소특검’이란 쌍두마차, 전재수를 흔든다)

Ahead of the June local elections, the political landscape in Busan is in turmoil. Just a month ago, the dominant pace of Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo, who had achieved the 'Miracle on the Nakdong River Front,' seemed unshakable. However, starting in early May, the race has dramatically shifted into an unpredictable tight contest. A combination of a fierce comeback by People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon, various controversies surrounding Jeon, and a major setback from central political circles is once again shrouding the sentiment of Busan residents in fog. <<> Until early April, Jeon was leading Park by double digits outside the margin of error in various polls. His practical image as 'Busan's son' and a 'hardworking lawmaker' was a powerful weapon that resonated even in the conservative-leaning city of Busan. However, a deep analysis of big data using SomeTrend from April 27 to May 7 reveals the reasons behind the decline in Jeon's approval ratings. <<> The most damaging is the 'bribery allegations' and 'non-referral controversy' linked to Jeon. It is a particularly painful point that, in the big data sentiment analysis, key associated words for Jeon include 'criticism,' 'controversy,' 'allegations,' and 'bribery' at the top. The police's decision not to refer the related allegations as soon as Jeon announced his mayoral run turned out to be a double-edged sword. The People Power Party framed this as 'granting a pardon by the authorities' and launched a full-scale attack, which is believed to have influenced the defection of the 2030 generation and swing voters sensitive to the value of fairness. <<> In contrast, Park has consolidated his support base by using positive keywords such as 'Busan City,' 'does a good job,' and 'trust' as a defensive wall. By leveraging his incumbent premium to emphasize 'stable city administration,' while relentlessly targeting the moral flaws of his opponent, Park succeeded in narrowing the gap to within the margin of error. Ultimately, the 'moral superiority' that was Jeon's strength has been shaken, leading to a rapid restructuring of the race. <<> The 'Motion to Withdraw Indictment and Special Counsel Bill Related to President Lee Jae-myung,' currently heating up Yeouido, is also a variable in the Busan mayoral election. While the Democratic Party asserts the justification of investigating the alleged manipulated indictment of the President by the prosecution, the People Power Party defines it as an 'unconstitutional special counsel' and an 'usurpation of the judiciary' aimed at clearing the President himself of criminal charges. <<> Busan is a city that has traditionally held a strict standard against central power monopolies or immorality. The stronger the framing that the President is pushing legislation to exonerate himself, the greater the burden it inevitably places on Democratic Party candidate Jeon. Particularly, with 'Democratic Party' and 'Lee Jae-myung' strongly tied as associated words for Jeon in big data analysis, the central party's reckless legislative attempts risk tarnishing Jeon's established image as a 'local worker' into that of a 'regime defender.' <<> The Democratic Party is adopting a strategy to delay this issue until after the local elections, but figures like the Park Hyung-joon camp and former leader Han Dong-hoon are already using it as a core basis for a 'verdict in the local elections.' Whether Busan citizens view this election as choosing a 'suitable person to lead city administration well' or as an 'election to check the arrogance of central power' will determine Jeon's fate. <<> The key issue that will decide the winner in this Busan mayoral election is expected to be a showdown between 'fairness and morality' versus 'continuity and development of city administration.' As the big data analysis shows, Jeon has suffered significant damage on the 'morality' front. As long as the terms 'bribery' and 'pardon' are attached to Jeon's name, winning over swing voters will not be easy. If Jeon fails to fully clear the allegations and the special counsel controversy from the central party persists until the final stages of the election, Busan voters are likely to turn away from Jeon, choosing the value of 'fairness.' <<> Conversely, Park is advocating for 'stability' and 'performance.' The assessment that he 'does a good job' is his strongest support base. However, he too has not fully erased negative keywords linked to various past incidents (such as 'crime' and 'gone wrong'). Ultimately, Busan citizens will ponder between the questions of 'Who is cleaner?' and 'Who is better at designing Busan's future?' <<> The by-election for the National Assembly seat in Busan's Buk-gu Gap, triggered by the resignation of Assemblyman Jeon Jae-soo, holds significance beyond a mere local district election. This area is Jeon's political home base and strongest support foundation. However, Buk-gu Gap has now become the largest battleground nationwide, with candidates Ha Jeong-woo (Democratic Party), Park Min-sik (People Power Party), and Han Dong-hoon (Independent) clashing. In particular, the presence of former leader Han Dong-hoon, running as an independent, is shaking up the entire Busan mayoral race. Han has been daily targeting Jeon's moral issues, intensifying his attacks. The negative messages against Jeon emanating from Buk-gu Gap are spreading throughout Busan, acting as downward pressure on the mayoral election. <<> If Democratic Party candidate Ha struggles in Buk-gu Gap or discussions of conservative unification gain rapid momentum, it would be interpreted as a sign that Jeon's 'home turf' is collapsing, critically impacting his mayoral election approval ratings. Conversely, if Jeon demonstrates overwhelming control in his own district, he could leverage that momentum to stage a rebound in city-wide support. In the end, Buk-gu Gap has become both a 'fortress' that Jeon must defend and a 'strategic vantage point' for Park to choke off his opponent's momentum. <<> Currently, the Busan mayoral election is a tight contest between Jeon's moral risks and the central political special counsel controversy, against Park's stable city administration framework. Big data is already warning that public sentiment is rapidly shifting. For Jeon to regain the upper hand, he must provide explanations at a level that voters can accept, rather than dismissing the allegations against him as mere 'political attacks.' He also needs to restore his image as a 'mayor solely for Busan' by distancing himself from the central party. <<> Meanwhile, to sustain his comeback momentum, Park must strengthen his moral offensive while presenting a future vision and once again proving the 'capabilities of the incumbent mayor.' Which hand will Busan citizens raise? Will 'practicality' defeat 'stability' and choose new change, or will 'stability' suppress 'controversy' and opt for continuity in city administration? (6월 지방선거를 앞두고 부산 정치 지형이 요동치고 있다. 불과 한 달 전까지만 해도 ‘낙동강 전선의 기적’을 일궈냈던 더불어민주당 전재수 후보의 독주 체제가 굳건해 보였다. 하지만 5월 초를 기점으로 판세는 예측 불허의 접전 양상으로 급변했다. 박형준 국민의힘 후보의 무서운 추격세와 전 후보를 둘러싼 각종 논란, 그리고 중앙 정치권 대형 악재가 결합하며 부산 민심은 다시금 안개 속으로 빠져들고 있다.)
